name: Banh trang dap
summary: Bánh tráng đập, also called bánh tráng chập, is a crisp grilled rice cracker clapped to a warm, chewy steamed sheet. You break it by hand and dip it in mắm nêm that is spicy and salty.
origin: Da Nang and the old Quảng Nam province. With hến xào, it is a Hội An plate.
texture: Bánh chập is two things clapped together: mì lá and a crisp grilled rice cracker. The steamed sheet is warm, chewy, and still soft, against the cracker.
taste: Spicy and salty. The dip is mắm nêm from anchovy, with a little sugar, pineapple or lime, and red chili.
howToEat: Break the rice paper by hand into small pieces.
Eat the crisp cracker with the warm steamed sheet and the mắm nêm.
where: In Da Nang, Bắc Mỹ An market, 25 Nguyễn Bá Lân, from about 08:00 to 19:00.
In Hội An, with stir-fried baby clams, hến xào.
seoTitle: Banh trang dap — break the rice paper
seoDescription: Bánh tráng đập is a crisp grilled rice cracker clapped to a warm steamed sheet, broken by hand and dipped in spicy, salty mắm nêm.
